new_scholarship.name: President's International Entrance Scholarship
new_scholarship.duration: 4 years (renewable; years 2-4 payments conditional on a minimum 80.0% previous-year average)
new_scholarship.deadline: No scholarship application is required; eligible students are notified through their offer of admission. The award search entry E1479 publishes no deadline, and awards are made "at the time of the offer of admission or in May and/or in August".
new_scholarship.application_period: Automatic on admission for Fall 2027 entry. There is no separate scholarship application window. U of G considers the admission application and scholarship eligibility "when the required curriculum-specific supporting documentation, as stated on the Admission Services website, is received", and successful recipients are informed with their offer of admission. Students who do not qualify on the initial offer are re-considered in May and/or August.
new_scholarship.application_method: Automatic on admission. No separate scholarship application is required and no scholarship portal is used. Eligibility is assessed from the admission file by Admission Services; the award is communicated with the offer of admission.
new_scholarship.description: The President's International Entrance Scholarship is the University of Guelph's flagship international entrance award for students entering semester one of any degree program while paying international tuition. Value is banded on the admission average and payable over four years: for the 2027 entry cycle a 95.0%+ admission average receives $20,000 in year 1 plus $7,500 in each of years 2-4, a total of $42,500 CAD. Awarded automatically with the offer of admission, it requires no separate application. It is a partial award, not a tuition waiver: recipients must continue to pay full international tuition and fees, and years 2-4 are conditional on maintaining a minimum 80.0% average while registered full-time.
new_scholarship.best_fit: High-achieving international applicants entering their first post-secondary degree at the University of Guelph who pay international tuition and have not previously attended a post-secondary institution.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to international (non-Canadian) applicants who pay international student tuition, apply as an international student applicant, are entering semester one of any degree program at the University of Guelph, have not previously attended a post-secondary institution, and have a record of high academic achievement. Selection is banded on the admission average calculated by U of G Admission Services (Canadian curriculum grading scale or equivalent as determined by International Admission). Recipients must register full-time in both the fall and winter semesters, must continue to pay international tuition and fees, and must achieve a minimum 80.0% average in their previous academic year of full-time study to receive years 2-4.

new_scholarship.selection_notes: Selection is made on a competitive basis and based on the admission average "at the time of the offer of admission or in May and/or in August". No published point weighting, rubric or separate selection committee is described for this award; the value is banded solely on the admission average calculated by U of G Admission Services, which determines averages for applicants not studying in a Canadian secondary school curriculum based on curriculum, grading practices and grading scale interpretation. If a student offered the scholarship subsequently pays domestic tuition and fees, the scholarship value is updated to the domestic values (University of Guelph Entrance Scholarship E0291). Entrance scholarships cannot be deferred; students who defer admission are reconsidered the following year based on availability for that cohort.
new_scholarship.notes: Assignment row b88 in ASSIGNMENTS.md named this slot "University of Guelph International Scholarships". No award with that exact name exists on uoguelph.ca. programme_detail_official.description: The President's International Entrance Scholarship is the University of Guelph's flagship automatic-on-admission international entrance award. U of G states that international students can 'Earn up to $42,500 CAD in international entrance scholarships over four years!' and that these awards are 'Receive a guaranteed entrance scholarship based on your admission average, payable over four years. No scholarship application is required, with eligible students being notified through their offer of admission.' For the 2027 entry cycle, year 1 is banded from $10,000 (70.0-84.9% admission average) to $20,000 (95.0%+) and years 2-4 pay $7,500 per year, giving four-year totals from $32,500 to $42,500 CAD. The award is limited to international applicants paying international tuition who are entering semester one of any degree program and have not previously attended post-secondary study. It is a partial award: recipients must continue to pay international tuition and fees.
programme_detail_official.program_type: University merit scholarship (international entrance, automatic on admission)
programme_detail_official.coverage: Tuition-fee credit applied to the University of Guelph student account in two equal payments over the fall and winter semesters, with conditional renewal in years 2-4. No living-cost, travel or health-insurance coverage.

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to the University of Guelph through the international undergraduate admission application and complete every item Admission Services requests.
Send the curriculum-specific supporting documentation for your education system early; the scholarship decision is triggered when Admission Services has received it, not when you apply.

Check your admission average against the published bands (70.0-84.9%, 85.0-89.9%, 90.0-94.9%, 95.0%+) and aim for the top band, since each band step changes both the year 1 amount and the four-year total.
Read the offer of admission carefully: the scholarship is announced with the offer, so there is nothing separate to submit afterwards.
If you miss the band on your first offer, remember the University re-considered in May and August, so keep your marks up in later terms.
Budget for the international difference: the award is applied to your student account as tuition credit but does not remove the requirement to pay international tuition and fees.
If you are transferring rather than entering from high school, check the separate International Transfer Scholarship instead; the transfer route is not covered by this award.
Use the Undergraduate Award Search to see whether additional awards in your program or college stack with this one.
common_rejection_risks: Deferring the offer of admission: entrance scholarships cannot be deferred, and the deferred applicant is only reconsidered the following year based on availability.
Falling below the 80.0% renewal average in a full-time year, which cancels years 2-4; lost payments cannot be added to the end of the award period.
Dropping below full-time registration in either the fall or winter semester, which reduces or cancels the award value.
Paying domestic tuition and fees after the offer, which downgrades the award to the domestic University of Guelph Entrance Scholarship (E0291) values.
Having previous post-secondary study: the award requires that the applicant has not attended a post-secondary institution.
Incomplete supporting documentation, so Admission Services never triggers the scholarship consideration.
Assuming a March 8, 2027 deadline applies here; that date is for the Dr. Franco J. Vaccarino President's Scholarship only, and missing it forfeits that separate $42,500 award.
Planning a major or college change that breaks a related college-specific international Dean's award renewal condition.
estimated_uncovered_costs: Full international tuition remains payable in full: the University publishes $46,780 CAD (most Bachelor of Arts/Science programs) to $66,099 CAD (Bachelor of Computing, Bachelor of Engineering) per year on a 2025-26 basis, and $101,634 CAD for the Doctor of Veterinary Medicine.
Compulsory fees of $1,748-$2,297 CAD per year are not covered.
University Health Insurance Plan (UHIP) of $948 CAD per year is not covered.
Textbooks estimated at $1,400 CAD per year are not covered.
Residence room of $8,387-$11,742 CAD per year is not covered, except for the 2 winners of the separate Vaccarino President's Scholarship who receive guaranteed on-campus residence.
A mandatory meal plan of $5,750-$7,850 CAD per year in residence is not covered.
Personal expenses estimated at $2,500 CAD per year are not covered.
A non-refundable tuition deposit of $2,000 CAD is required to show commitment.
Immigration Canada requires proof of funds for one full year of tuition and living expenses for a study permit, and the University warns about its 'Fees Guarantee' cap of 5% annual tuition increases.
Travel costs are explicitly outside the estimate; the University's own guidance says to factor in travel and equipment fees separately.

submission_workflow: Submit the University of Guelph undergraduate admission application as an international applicant.
Provide the curriculum-specific supporting documentation required by Admission Services for your education system.
Await the offer of admission; scholarship eligibility is assessed at that point and confirmed with the offer.
If the admission average misses the published band, maintain the highest average possible so you are re-considered in May and/or August.
Accept the offer and register full-time in both the fall and winter semesters; the award is not paid unless you are registered.
The award is applied to your student account in two equal payments across the fall and winter semesters.
Each subsequent year, achieve a minimum 80.0% average over a full-time fall/winter year and continue paying international tuition and fees to receive the renewal payment.

logo_override.validation_detail: png 9378B. HTTP 200 returned with Content-Type image/png on www.uoguelph.ca (official host). Pixel scan of all 22500 pixels: 0 fully transparent pixels, 20538 dark pixels, 719 coloured pixels, 1133 near-white pixels; visual check confirms the University's own crest above a 'UNIVERSITY OF GUELPH' wordmark on an opaque dark ground. Because the background is opaque rather than transparent, this is not the white-on-transparent wordmark excluded by PART D rule 6.

research_notes.logo: Found in the site header markup of the official award search page https://www.uoguelph.ca/regweb/studentfinance/apps/awards?id=E1479, which loads //www.uoguelph.ca/img/universityofguelph.png with alt text 'University of Guelph homepage.'. Probed live: HEAD returned HTTP 200 with Content-Type image/png (9378 bytes). Downloaded and scanned every pixel of the 150x150 image to satisfy PART D rule 6: no fully transparent pixels and 91% dark pixels, and a visual check shows the crest plus wordmark on an opaque dark ground, so it is not a white-on-transparent wordmark. official_host is true because the bytes are served by www.uoguelph.ca, the University's own registrable domain. https://www.uoguelph.ca/img/universityofguelph.svg (49271 bytes, HTTP 200, image/svg+xml) and /favicon.ico (HTTP 200, image/vnd.microsoft.ico) also exist but the SVG contains 20 explicit #fff fills that could not be safely rendered and checked within the fetch budget, so the PNG was chosen as the verified option. The full-colour white-background lockup linked on the international funding page is served from api.liveugconthub.uoguelph.dev, a different registrable domain (uoguelph.dev), so it was rejected under rule 3. uoguelph.ca was not already a key in official_logo_overrides.json and ASSIGNMENTS.md row b88 has logo_host_taken = false, so no dedupe is expected at merge time. NOTE FOR THE MERGE: validate_bachelor.js emits a warning 'logo_override.url does not look like a logo asset' for this record. That is a filename heuristic only (it tests the URL for logo|brand|wordmark|favicon|icon and this file is named universityofguelph.png); it is not a validity failure. The asset itself was probed live and visually confirmed, so the override should be kept as-is rather than swapped for the lower-quality favicon.ico.
